description:
Cast Prized Statue by paying {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Prized Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Prized Statue.
When Prized Statue leaves the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Myr Retriever.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Prized Statue from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
